title: Ground states for strongly indefinite Schrödinger equations with competing nonlinearities
summary: We survey recent variational methods for strongly indefinite Schrödinger equations with sign-changing nonlinearities. The main object is an energy functional of the form \[ J(u)=\frac12\|u^+\|^2-\frac12\|u^-\|^2 -\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}F(u)\,dx+λ\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}G(u)\,dx, \] where the splitting $X=X^+\oplus X^-$ is induced by a spectral gap of the linear Schrödinger operator, and where the nonlinear part \[ I(u)=\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}F(u)\,dx-λ\int_{\mathbb{R}^N}G(u)\,dx \] is allowed to change sign.
